summary: Claims and tax professional with about 10 years of experience in insurance claims adjusting, with an emphasis on first- and third-party automobile liability and property damage claims. Background includes claim investigation, evidence collection, repair estimate analysis, and negotiation of total loss and bodily injury settlements. Also worked as a tax examining clerk adjusting 1040X amended returns, researching tax data, and identifying indications of fraud, and previously ran a dairy distribution business handling accounts receivable, reconciliations, and inventory control. Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Access, and Word with strong analytical and customer communication skills.
